fitAnalysis.assessment:
This is a weak fit at 48%, with core FP&A skills in place but real gaps in cloud spend and accounting depth.

**Strengths:**
- Five years of budgeting, rolling forecasts and variance analysis
- Month-end reporting and freight invoice reconciliations supporting the audit file
- Power BI dashboards on SAP data, plus a rebuilt backlog model

**Gaps:**
- No cloud or AI vendor spend, billing data or FinOps experience
- No accruals, allocations or vendor spend management shown
- ACCA incomplete (9 of 13 papers); corporate finance and accounting depth unproven

**Recommendation:** Build cloud cost and FinOps knowledge (such as the FinOps Foundation certification) and gain accruals experience before applying to senior roles like this one.

Dear Hiring Manager,

Forecasts only help engineering and finance leaders if they hold up against actuals. At Calder Industrial Components, the larger of my two business units had a forecast accuracy of 88%, so I rebuilt the model around order backlog and brought it to 96%. Your Cloud Hosting role asks for the same discipline: forecast models that reflect actual results, usage drivers and business drivers.

As a Financial Analyst with 5 years of experience in budgeting, forecasting and month-end reporting, I own the monthly forecast and variance reporting for two business units. I also cut month-end close reporting from 9 working days to 6 by automating journal checks in Excel VBA, and I build Power BI dashboards on SAP data for plant managers who need clear answers, not raw data. I haven't worked with cloud billing data yet, but variance analysis, financial modeling and explaining results to non-finance partners transfer directly. I'm also working towards my ACCA qualification, with 9 of 13 papers passed. Your all-remote, asynchronous setup suits how I work: I own my deliverables and flag risks early.

Supporting decisions on cloud and AI infrastructure investments under the Manager, FP&A is the kind of work I want to grow into. I'm available to talk whenever suits your team and can start the conversation right away.

Best regards,
Tomas Brandt
